Subject: Your maritime salvage claim matter - A.S. No. 1810/2024

Dear Mr. Gaikwad,

Thank you for meeting us on 23 November 2024 about your dispute with M/s Swamy Shipping Pvt Ltd. As we understand it, the vessel is about to leave port.

Our advice is to arrest the vessel to secure the salvage claim. Please collect the salvage agreement and the logbook entries and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Tejas Oberoi
